reviews.title: Garbage!!

reviews.title: Hasn’t worked in months
reviews.text: I’ve been paying for consumer reports for about a decade. I don’t use it all the time. It’s clutch when shopping for appliances or a used car. Now my dad needs hearing aids and his buddy spent $3k on some and they don’t even work, so naturally I go to open the CR app and “something went wrong” atop a white screen is all I get. This has been the case for months. Never seen an app fail like this for this long. I’m starting to wonder if Consumer Reports is failing as an organization. Might be just another case of greedy c suite management bleeding the organization dry.

reviews.title: No longer works
reviews.text:
Approaching 50 years of subscribing over 3 generations of my family, we have been believers and supporters of Consumer Reports, but as everything in life, all good things end sooner or later.

For the last year no one in my family has been able to sign into CR with either apps or on various devices and different browsers. The web site continually says it is down and to go to the main page. This has been going on for close to two years.

I just downloaded the app on a new device and when opened it simply shows the green screen saying Consumer Reports and provides no login screen.

We understand that this could be an isolated case and our investigations and reverse engineering efforts seem to explain what the unacceptable explanations may be.

Funny that a renewal notice was recently sent. Sorry to say we wont put our family at risk due to some false whims, although we understand that CR needs to protect itself from hackers and misinformation.

Would have been nice to reach 50 years but it’s not worth the risk.

reviews.title: Love CR
reviews.text: After the new update to fix bugs, I now have bugs.  Cannot get a full screen or search for topics.

reviews.title: Severely limited
reviews.text: Consumer Reports has a long reputation for rigorous product testing. You won’t find that for most products in the app. Instead, you’ll find an AI chat bot and a bunch of generic number ratings with no explanations. Save your money and append “Reddit” to your searches.

reviews.title: AI Disaster
reviews.text: I’m a long time supporter of Consumer Reports but only use it a few times a year to help decide on major purchases. Today Im trying to check on a personal electronic device and am stuck in AI chat hell. I enter the name of the device and get… nothing. No response, no alternative, just a blank blue screen with video snowflakes. What has happened to the thoughtful, informative response I’ve always gotten. Cancelling my membership.

reviews.title: Money Hungry
reviews.text: I subscribed to Consumer Reports both digitally and to receive the magazine.  Frequently I receive emails and snail mail solicitations for donations.  I paid for your services already plus today I received a “raffle” solicitation, again asking for another donation.  How much of your solicited monies were used for the printing and mailing of this raffle?  I have cancelled my renewal and will no longer be using your services.
